sloka: स यदा यौवनं भद्रमनुप्राप्तो निशाचरः ।ततो दारक्रियां तस्य कर्तुं व्यवसितः पिता ।। ७.४.१९ ॥
transliteration: sa yadā yauvanaṁ bhadramanuprāpto niśācaraḥ ।tato dārakriyāṁ tasya kartuṁ vyavasitaḥ pitā ।। 7.4.19 ॥

translations.english: When the night-wanderer (Vidhyutkesha) attained auspicious youth, his father then resolved to perform his marriage ceremony.
